sections.title: The frame
sections.note: What exists in VESPER's home regardless of what it's doing. This is the shell everything else mounts into — the part you said you'd specify, so treat these as candidates rather than decisions.

rows.name: Presence indicator
rows.what: Whether VESPER is awake, thinking, acting, waiting on you, or degraded. One glance, no reading.

rows.name: Say something
rows.what: Persistent input — typed or spoken. Never a modal; always reachable.

rows.name: Current attention
rows.what: The one thing VESPER is on right now, in plain words, with a way to interrupt it.

rows.name: Needs you
rows.what: Queue of things waiting on your decision. Empty most of the time; loud when not.

rows.name: Emergency stop
rows.what: Always present, never nested in a menu. A dead-man's switch, not a kill signal.

rows.name: Degradation banner
rows.what: What VESPER currently cannot do and why. Every excluded capability is reported, never silently dropped.

rows.name: Window composition
rows.what: Whether VESPER's home holds one window or several, and who decides — you or it.

rows.name: Space switching
rows.what: Jump to VESPER's home from anywhere. Ctrl+1 confirmed working; enable Desktop 2 once VESPER's Space exists.

rows.name: Global summon
rows.what: Hotkey that brings VESPER forward without leaving what you're doing.

rows.name: Command palette
rows.what: Keyboard-first access to every surface in this document.

rows.name: What changed since I looked
rows.what: A digest of everything that moved while you were away.

rows.name: Undo VESPER
rows.what: A stack of everything VESPER did, each individually reversible.

rows.name: Thinking trace
rows.what: A readable summary of VESPER's reasoning on the current task, collapsible.

rows.name: Focus mode
rows.what: Hide everything except the thing you're working on.

rows.name: Pin a panel
rows.what: Keep any panel always-visible regardless of context.

rows.name: Global search
rows.what: One search across memory, history, tasks, files and config.

rows.name: Density control
rows.what: Compact / comfortable, because 145 rows of anything needs it.

rows.name: Multi-monitor behaviour
rows.what: Which screen VESPER's home claims when you dock.

rows.name: Shortcut map
rows.what: Every keyboard shortcut, discoverable rather than memorised.

rows.name: Boot state
rows.what: What VESPER restored on start, and what it couldn't.

sections.title: This machine
sections.note: Host condition, and the surface where the lifetime goal actually gets served. All of this reads live today through core/host.py — no new plumbing needed to show it.

rows.name: Thermal pressure
rows.what: Nominal / fair / serious / critical. Unreadable counts as pressure, never as health.

rows.name: Memory headroom
rows.what: Real reclaimable memory, translated — not the alarming 'free' figure that reads 0.16 GB on a healthy machine.

rows.name: Memory pressure band
rows.what: The kernel's own signal, shown as a band. Never converted to gigabytes — it doesn't track allocation.

rows.name: Compressor & swap
rows.what: How hard the compressor is working, and whether swap has turned on. Swap is the SSD-wear tripwire.

rows.name: Battery health
rows.what: Capacity, cycles, temperature history, daily charge range. The numbers that decide the ten-year question.

rows.name: Charge policy
rows.what: Charge limit state, and whether the machine is sitting at high charge — the mechanism that aged this pack to 84% in a shop.

rows.name: Power draw
rows.what: Whole-machine watts split into compute vs everything else. Compute is 8% at idle — the split is the insight.

rows.name: Wake assertions
rows.what: What is holding the machine awake and for how long. The single largest lifetime lever found so far.

rows.name: Process energy
rows.what: Per-process power attribution — who is actually costing you battery, ranked.

rows.name: Owner working set
rows.what: What's resident right now, so a headroom number is interpretable rather than just a figure.

rows.name: Storage & SSD
rows.what: Free space, TRIM, SMART, and cumulative write pressure.

rows.name: Thermal history
rows.what: Temperature over time against ambient — the variable that matters most in site B heat.

rows.name: Lifetime projection
rows.what: Where the battery is heading on current habits, and what changes it. Honest about slope, not promises.

rows.name: Stewardship advice
rows.what: Tier-2 findings: what VESPER noticed, what it would do, and the button that does it. Advice never acts on its own.

rows.name: Node calibration
rows.what: Run the measurement protocol, review results, and promote them into the contract as a reviewed act.

rows.name: Fan & acoustics
rows.what: Fan speed and noise — heat you can hear before you can measure it.

rows.name: Display power
rows.what: Brightness and its real cost. The display dominates idle drain, so this is a bigger lever than CPU.

rows.name: Radio state
rows.what: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth power cost, and what's keeping them awake.

rows.name: Disk I/O rate
rows.what: Live read/write throughput, and cumulative writes against SSD endurance.

rows.name: Sleep & wake log
rows.what: Every sleep, wake, and what woke it. Where mystery battery drain gets explained.

rows.name: Throttle events
rows.what: When the machine actually throttled, and what was running.

rows.name: Ambient estimate
rows.what: Inferred room temperature — the ceiling the battery can never get below.

rows.name: Charging schedule
rows.what: When to charge, given your day, to minimise time at high state of charge.

rows.name: Costing me now
rows.what: Live ranked list of what is draining the battery this minute.

rows.name: Maintenance actions
rows.what: Things worth doing occasionally, surfaced when they're due rather than remembered.

rows.name: Peripherals
rows.what: What's plugged in, what it draws, and what it keeps awake.

rows.name: Before/after
rows.what: Measure a change you made and show whether it actually helped.

sections.title: Nodes & fabric
sections.note: The graph you asked for: every machine, every path between them, and the trust that results. Trust is the weaker of the node and the path it's reached over — a good machine on a bad network gets demoted, and a network can never raise trust.

rows.name: Node graph
rows.what: Every node, its state, its reachability and what it's carrying. The system-health view.

rows.name: Node profiles
rows.what: What each machine measurably sustains. UNKNOWN means unavailable, and shows as such.

rows.name: Trust zones
rows.what: Z0–Z3 per node, with the reason each landed where it did.

rows.name: Network segments
rows.what: Private / shared / outside, each with its trust ceiling. No addresses, no product names.

rows.name: Attestation state
rows.what: Whether a VESPER-controlled segment exists and is attested. Today: false, so no node is a full host.

rows.name: Placement decisions
rows.what: Where each capability currently runs and why it was placed there, including what lost.

rows.name: Relocation history
rows.what: When VESPER moved, what triggered it, and the damping that stopped it flapping.

rows.name: Survival profile
rows.what: What VESPER carries onto the last device standing, and what it drops.

rows.name: Enrollment
rows.what: Admit a new machine, measure it, and watch it earn placement on merit.

rows.name: Endpoints
rows.what: Every surface VESPER can reach you through, as profiles rather than device names.

rows.name: Control-plane lease
rows.what: Which node holds control, its fencing token, and its refusal to self-promote.

rows.name: Link quality
rows.what: Latency, throughput and reliability per path — measured at enrollment, never declared.

rows.name: Partition state
rows.what: What's unreachable right now and what that costs. Failure direction is stated, not guessed.

rows.name: Node comparison
rows.what: Two machines side by side on every measured axis.

rows.name: Blast radius
rows.what: What breaks if a given node dies — simulated before it happens.

rows.name: Migration dry-run
rows.what: Move VESPER somewhere, in simulation, and see what degrades.

rows.name: Clock skew
rows.what: How far apart the nodes' clocks are — and the reminder that HLC, not wall clock, decides order.

rows.name: Key & identity state
rows.what: Each node's keys, where they're stored, and which never leave the device.

rows.name: Onboarding wizard
rows.what: Walk a new machine from nothing to enrolled and measured.

rows.name: Node roles
rows.what: What each machine is FOR — always-on server, travelling laptop, phone endpoint.

rows.name: Failover drill
rows.what: Deliberately kill a node and prove recovery works. A negative control for the fabric.

sections.title: What it's doing
sections.note: Activity, in a form where you can see it, steer it, and stop it. The autonomy layer is where VESPER acts without being asked, which is exactly why it needs the most visible surface.

rows.name: Task graph
rows.what: Live tasks, dependencies, checkpoints and what resumes if power drops.

rows.name: Autonomy queue
rows.what: What VESPER intends to do unprompted, before it does it.

rows.name: Triggers
rows.what: What can wake VESPER. Enforced to be state-shaped, never pure clock.

rows.name: Action outbox
rows.what: Every external side effect, durably recorded before it happens, with reconciliation state.

rows.name: Compensation
rows.what: What each in-flight action would undo if it fails partway.

rows.name: Emergency stop
rows.what: Halt everything. Independent of the thing it stops, by design.

rows.name: Model calls
rows.what: Every model request, its cost, its route, and why that model was chosen.

rows.name: Cost & period
rows.what: Spend against budget, and which operating period VESPER thinks it's in.

rows.name: Verification state
rows.what: What's been verified, what's asserted, and the refusal to let repetition count as success.

rows.name: Interruption budget
rows.what: What reached you today, what waited, and what was suppressed.

rows.name: Live activity stream
rows.what: A running narration of what VESPER is doing, at a granularity you set.

rows.name: Interject
rows.what: Redirect VESPER mid-task without killing the task.

rows.name: Pause / resume
rows.what: Hold one task without stopping everything else.

rows.name: Reprioritise
rows.what: Drag the queue into the order you actually want.

rows.name: Lookahead
rows.what: What VESPER is about to do next, before it starts.

rows.name: Dry run
rows.what: Execute a plan with all side effects suppressed, and show what would have happened.

rows.name: Estimated completion
rows.what: How long this will take, based on measured history rather than a guess.

rows.name: Retry policy
rows.what: What VESPER does when something fails, per task class.

rows.name: Work rate
rows.what: Throughput over time — is VESPER actually getting things done.

rows.name: Stall detection
rows.what: Notice when something has been 'in progress' far too long, and say so.

rows.name: Scheduled work
rows.what: Things queued for a time or a condition, and what will trigger them.

sections.title: Permissions & governance
sections.note: The surface where you decide what VESPER may do — to this machine, to your apps, to the world. Risk class is declared in a contract, never judged at runtime, and nothing above the read line turns on without you.

rows.name: Host action vocabulary
rows.what: All 13 declared actions by tier, what each does, whether it's enabled, and its inverse.

rows.name: Enable / disable actions
rows.what: Turn a tier-3 action on. A governed act with a recorded authorisation, not a toggle.

rows.name: Rule authoring
rows.what: Write the pre-authorised rule — 'you may demote anything holding a wake assertion past 2h' — so VESPER can act at 3am without waking you.

rows.name: Capability registry
rows.what: Every capability, its level, and the constants that are refused outright.

rows.name: Authorization
rows.what: The single evaluator every action resolves against, and what it decided.

rows.name: Grants
rows.what: Standing permissions, their scope, and their expiry.

rows.name: Self-modification boundary
rows.what: What VESPER may propose about itself, and the merge it may never perform.

rows.name: Governed surfaces
rows.what: Which files require review, and who reviews them.

rows.name: Taint & context ceiling
rows.what: How untrusted input is prevented from raising VESPER's authority.

rows.name: Hardware access
rows.what: Camera, microphone, screen, files — what's granted, what's in use, and a capture indicator that can't lie.

rows.name: macOS permissions
rows.what: Accessibility, Screen Recording, Automation — what's granted, what's needed for which feature, and why.

rows.name: Behaviour on / off this Mac
rows.what: Different rules when VESPER is here versus running on another node.

rows.name: Consent channel policy
rows.what: Which tiers may be approved by voice and which need a tap you make yourself.

rows.name: Refusal log
rows.what: Everything VESPER wanted to do and was refused, with the reason. Escalation attempts made visible.

rows.name: Permission inbox
rows.what: Pending requests in one place, each with the evidence behind it.

rows.name: Time-limited grants
rows.what: Permission that expires by itself — 'you may do this for the next two hours'.

rows.name: What could you do now?
rows.what: A plain-language answer to exactly what VESPER is currently permitted to do.

rows.name: Panic revoke
rows.what: Drop every standing grant at once, without stopping VESPER.

rows.name: Per-app rules
rows.what: What VESPER may touch in each application, separately.

rows.name: Grant templates
rows.what: Reusable permission sets — 'study mode', 'travel mode', 'hands off'.

rows.name: Quiet-hours restrictions
rows.what: Narrower permissions at night than during the day.

rows.name: Approval history
rows.what: Everything you've ever approved, and the chance to withdraw any of it.

rows.name: Escalation alerts
rows.what: Tell me when VESPER asks for more than it had before.

sections.title: Memory & knowledge
sections.note: Editable memory, as you asked — with the one hard rule that keeps it safe: knowledge that drives an action on your machine must be measured here, never something VESPER read somewhere and believed.

rows.name: Memory browser
rows.what: Read, search, edit and delete what VESPER remembers.

rows.name: Provenance
rows.what: Where each memory came from and how much weight it carries.

rows.name: Learning kinds
rows.what: Host operation · domain · owner model · skill · research. Separately governed, because they carry different risk.

rows.name: Lifetime lessons
rows.what: What VESPER learned about keeping this machine alive, and the measurement behind each.

rows.name: OS practice
rows.what: Learned platform behaviour — what action caused what, verified here rather than read online.

rows.name: Owner model
rows.what: How you work, when you're around, your tone. Private, and yours to correct.

rows.name: Personality
rows.what: Humour, sarcasm, roasting, formality — dialled per context rather than globally.

rows.name: World model
rows.what: Facts VESPER holds about the world, which expire to UNKNOWN rather than going stale silently.

rows.name: Conflicts
rows.what: Facts that disagree, held as conflicts rather than silently resolved.

rows.name: Evidence & claims
rows.what: What backs each assertion, so a correction can supersede one element rather than the whole answer.

rows.name: Knowledge maps
rows.what: Structured domain knowledge — the shape of what VESPER knows about a subject.

rows.name: Promotion review
rows.what: Learned artifacts waiting to become active, and the rule that one outcome can't change the set.

rows.name: Rollback
rows.what: Revert any learned artifact individually, or the whole set.

rows.name: Record loss
rows.what: What VESPER knows it has forgotten, and what that costs.

rows.name: Forget this
rows.what: Direct deletion, with a tombstone so the deletion itself is auditable.

rows.name: Why do you think that?
rows.what: Trace any belief back through the evidence that produced it.

rows.name: Pinned facts
rows.what: Things VESPER must never forget or overwrite.

rows.name: Contradiction inbox
rows.what: New information that disagrees with something held, surfaced for you to settle.

rows.name: Confidence & decay
rows.what: How sure VESPER is, and how that fades with time.

rows.name: Memory diff
rows.what: What VESPER learned this week, as a reviewable change set.

rows.name: Import / export
rows.what: Take your memory with you, or seed it from somewhere else.

rows.name: Redaction
rows.what: Mark something as never-to-be-repeated without deleting the record of it.

rows.name: Correct me
rows.what: Fix a wrong belief directly, and see everything downstream that changes.

sections.title: Work, study & research
sections.note: The part that serves you directly — your degree programme, plus everything else you build. This is also where the interactive session you described lives: windows arranged, content pulled, annotations drawn on top.

rows.name: Projects
rows.what: Long-running work with its own context, files, history and goals.

rows.name: Interactive session
rows.what: The case you described: windows arranged around a subject, content pulled, notes written, annotations drawn over the top.

rows.name: Annotation layer
rows.what: Pencil, arrows, shapes, text over any window or screen region. Needs a new scene element type.

rows.name: Window choreography
rows.what: VESPER opening and positioning apps around you. Accessibility permission; must be fast or it feels broken.

rows.name: Research
rows.what: Genuine investigation with sources, contradictions kept, and a written conclusion.

rows.name: Coursework
rows.what: Course material — subjects, deadlines, what you've covered, what you haven't.

rows.name: Coding
rows.what: Repositories, branches, review state, and what VESPER changed.

rows.name: AI / ML workbench
rows.what: Datasets, experiments, runs, metrics — the working surface for your degree.

rows.name: Local models
rows.what: What's installed, what fits in headroom, measured throughput, what's resident now.

rows.name: Files
rows.what: What VESPER can see, what it's touched, and what it may write.

rows.name: Context budget
rows.what: What went into an answer, what was dropped for budget, and the ceiling that resulted.

rows.name: Improvement backlog
rows.what: Ideas logged the moment they arise, with provenance. Never held only in a model's context.

rows.name: Experiments
rows.what: Registered experiments with pre-declared pass conditions, so results can't be reinterpreted after the fact.

rows.name: Driving other AIs
rows.what: Using another assistant through its interface rather than its API — typed or spoken.

rows.name: Session replay
rows.what: Re-open a past interactive session exactly as it was arranged.

rows.name: Layout templates
rows.what: Saved window arrangements for recurring kinds of work.

rows.name: Freeform canvas
rows.what: An infinite surface for thinking, that VESPER can also draw on.

rows.name: Spaced repetition
rows.what: Flashcards from your coursework, scheduled by what you're forgetting.

rows.name: Deadline tracker
rows.what: Exams, submissions and what's actually due next.

rows.name: Reading queue
rows.what: Papers and docs to get to, with VESPER's summary of each.

rows.name: Citation manager
rows.what: Sources, properly tracked, for work that gets marked.

rows.name: Notebook
rows.what: Executable notes — code, output and prose together.

rows.name: Dataset browser
rows.what: What data you have, its shape, and its problems.

rows.name: Run comparison
rows.what: Two training runs side by side, with the difference that mattered.

rows.name: Prompt library
rows.what: Prompts that worked, saved and reusable.

rows.name: Code review
rows.what: VESPER's changes, reviewable before they land.

rows.name: Study progress
rows.what: What you've actually covered against what the course requires.

rows.name: Explain this
rows.what: Point at anything on screen and get it explained in place.

rows.name: Lab notebook
rows.what: Dated, append-only record of what you tried and what happened.

sections.title: Configuration & calibration
sections.note: Every contract that shapes behaviour, editable in one place. Fifteen policy contracts exist today — each one is a panel. Ranges are immutable at runtime by design: VESPER may move a dial, never widen it.

rows.name: Tunables
rows.what: Every dial, its range, its current value, and who last moved it.

rows.name: Capability profiles
rows.what: What each capability requires. Measured values only — declared numbers are refused.

rows.name: Host actions
rows.what: The action vocabulary itself, as an editable reviewed artifact.

rows.name: Network fabric
rows.what: Segments, ceilings, attestation, and the control-traffic reservation.

rows.name: Cost policy
rows.what: Budgets, cost classes, and the choke point every model call crosses.

rows.name: Latency budgets
rows.what: Per-path time budgets. Immutable — a missed budget produces a limitation record, never a relaxed number.

rows.name: Degradation ladder
rows.what: What VESPER gives up first when it must give something up.

rows.name: Interruption budget
rows.what: How much VESPER may interrupt you, per class, per period.

rows.name: Trigger registry
rows.what: Everything that may wake VESPER, with the requirement that wanted each one.

rows.name: Persona policy
rows.what: Tone and character, per context.

rows.name: Execution classes
rows.what: Which work runs on which cores. Measured 5.25× clamp between interactive and deferrable.

rows.name: Operating periods
rows.what: When VESPER is free to work, quiet, or fully off.

rows.name: Model routing
rows.what: Which model handles which difficulty, against measured node capability.

rows.name: Backup & restore
rows.what: Snapshot the whole configuration, diff it, roll it back.

rows.name: Modes
rows.what: Study / travel / low-power / hands-off — whole configurations you switch between.

rows.name: Config diff
rows.what: What changed in settings since a point in time, and who changed it.

rows.name: Impact preview
rows.what: Before you save: what this change will actually alter.

rows.name: Explain this setting
rows.what: What a dial does, why the range is what it is, and what happens at each end.

rows.name: Scheduled changes
rows.what: Config that changes by time or condition — quieter after midnight.

rows.name: Reset to measured
rows.what: Throw away declared values and fall back to what was actually measured.

rows.name: Validate config
rows.what: Check the whole configuration is coherent before committing to it.

sections.title: History & audit
sections.note: What happened, in a form that survives. Ordering here is by hybrid logical clock, never wall clock — a timestamp can lie about order across machines, and this is the surface where that would matter most.

rows.name: Conversation history
rows.what: Everything said, searchable, with the context each answer used.

rows.name: Action log
rows.what: Every host action taken, its effect, and how to undo it.

rows.name: Decision log
rows.what: What VESPER decided and the inputs that produced it — replayable, not just recorded.

rows.name: Authorisation history
rows.what: What you approved, when, in what scope, and through which channel.

rows.name: Telemetry
rows.what: Structured events with sensitivity enforced at the writer, never by caller discipline.

rows.name: Tombstones
rows.what: What was deleted and when — so deletion itself leaves a trace.

rows.name: Incidents
rows.what: Failures, stalls, partitions and emergency stops, with what followed.

rows.name: Cost history
rows.what: Spend over time by model, task and period.

rows.name: Host timeline
rows.what: Thermal, memory, battery and power over time, with VESPER's own activity overlaid.

rows.name: Replay
rows.what: Reconstruct any past state from the log. Read-time upcasting means the log is never rewritten.

rows.name: Timeline scrubber
rows.what: Drag through time and watch every panel show that moment's state.

rows.name: Weekly digest
rows.what: What VESPER did this week, worth two minutes of reading.

rows.name: Anomalies
rows.what: Things that were unusual, surfaced without you having to look.

rows.name: Export audit
rows.what: Take the whole record out, in a form something else can read.

rows.name: Session bookmarks
rows.what: Mark a moment worth coming back to.

rows.name: What did you change?
rows.what: Every file VESPER touched, with diffs.

sections.title: Presence & interaction
sections.note: How VESPER reaches you, everywhere — not only in its own home. Dialogs cross every Space and float above any window; that part is free on macOS and needs no permission.

rows.name: Floating dialogs
rows.what: Appear over any app, in any Space. Answerable by click or just by speaking.

rows.name: Voice in
rows.what: Speak to VESPER without touching anything.

rows.name: Voice out
rows.what: VESPER speaks — with an interruption budget so it isn't constant.

rows.name: Scene rendering
rows.what: One scene, many surfaces. Intent in, layout out — the mechanism that covers your million cases.

rows.name: Scene element types
rows.what: Ten today. You want more; each new type must declare how it degrades, down to voice-only.

rows.name: Endpoint selection
rows.what: Which surface a scene goes to — resolving the private way when it's ambiguous.

rows.name: Privacy routing
rows.what: Nothing sensitive rendered where someone else can read it.

rows.name: Menu bar
rows.what: Ambient state at a glance, always visible without a window.

rows.name: Notifications
rows.what: Native macOS notifications for things that can wait for you to look.

rows.name: Alarms
rows.what: The escalation ladder, its hard cap, and the physical acknowledgment channel.

rows.name: Quiet hours
rows.what: When VESPER stays silent — and the alarm class that's exempt by design.

rows.name: Handoff
rows.what: Move a conversation between surfaces mid-sentence.

rows.name: Do not disturb
rows.what: One switch that means it, honoured everywhere.

rows.name: Voice & speed
rows.what: Which voice, how fast, and how much it says at once.

rows.name: Wake word
rows.what: Whether there is one, and what it is.

rows.name: Language
rows.what: Which language VESPER speaks and understands, per context.

rows.name: Transcripts
rows.what: Everything spoken, written down and searchable.

rows.name: Notification rules
rows.what: What deserves a notification versus a mention versus silence.

rows.name: Barge-in
rows.what: Interrupt VESPER mid-sentence and have it stop immediately.

rows.name: Ambient status
rows.what: A subtle always-on cue — colour, sound, motion — that reads without focus.

rows.name: Overlay HUD
rows.what: Information drawn over the screen without taking a window.

sections.title: Introspection
sections.note: VESPER examining itself. Unusual to put in a product interface, but this system is built on the claim that its boundaries are checked rather than asserted — so the checks should be visible.

rows.name: Invariants
rows.what: All 138 across 37 families, each with what enforces it and whether that's currently green.

rows.name: Gate status
rows.what: 30 checks, 75 self-tests, seven acceptance gates, three stress suites — live.

rows.name: Self-test evidence
rows.what: Each check deliberately broken and restored, with the red run recorded.

rows.name: Traceability
rows.what: Every requirement to its tests, contracts and checks — and the gaps, named.

rows.name: Spikes
rows.what: Time-boxed measurements with pass conditions and a disposition declared in advance.

rows.name: Decisions (ADRs)
rows.what: Architecture decisions, their status, and what each one closed.

rows.name: Limitation records
rows.what: Requirements that don't close on this hardware, with an R&D path. Never a relaxed requirement.

rows.name: Open proposals
rows.what: Changes VESPER wants to make to itself, awaiting your review.

rows.name: Build state
rows.what: Which stage each part of the system is at, and what's blocked on what.

rows.name: Explain yourself
rows.what: Ask VESPER why it did something and get the decision path, not a rationalisation.

rows.name: What are you unsure about?
rows.what: VESPER naming its own weak spots rather than waiting to be caught.

rows.name: Module map
rows.what: How the 34 runtime modules depend on each other.

rows.name: VESPER's own performance
rows.what: How much time and memory VESPER itself costs.

rows.name: Coverage map
rows.what: What is tested, what merely runs, and the difference.

rows.name: Changelog
rows.what: What changed in VESPER itself, in language you'd want to read.

rows.name: Red-run archive
rows.what: Every deliberate failure ever recorded, as evidence the gates work.

sections.title: Beyond the Mac
sections.note: VESPER is not pinned to a machine — that's an enforced invariant, and it's why the frontend is Tauri rather than native Swift. Its face has to be able to follow it.

rows.name: Cross-node behaviour
rows.what: What changes when VESPER runs somewhere else — and what must not.

rows.name: Platform adapters
rows.what: Per-platform translation of host signals. The knowledge lives in the adapter, never in shared logic.

rows.name: Remote surfaces
rows.what: Reaching VESPER from a phone or another machine.

rows.name: Follow-me
rows.what: The interface moving with VESPER as it relocates.

rows.name: Offline
rows.what: What still works with no network at all.

rows.name: External world
